svg.title: Agent turns on a device
svg.desc: 1. The agent sends tools/call with its bearer token; the server hashes it and finds the token under a token-hash database context. 2. Per-token limits apply (120 calls and 40 writes a minute), then the owner's access is checked. 3. The device name is resolved fuzzily; several matches return ambiguous with the candidates. 4. A sensitive device being turned on without confirm: true returns needs_confirmation. 5. The friendly command is translated with the device model and sent to Tuya. 6. The server reads the device state back and answers confirmed or not confirmed, then logs the action as from the agent.
